description: In front of you on the bed are a closed laptop, an open notebook with a pen, a paper cup, a plastic bottle, some crumpled tissues, two pieces of clothing, and an empty cardboard box. The left hand holds and pulls the cardboard box closer, while the right hand picks up the orange shirt and drops it into the box, then adds the green shirt, the plastic bottle and tissues, and finally lifts the paper cup and a small blue packet into the box before the left hand slides the now-filled box to the right side of the bed.
